# Known limitations

Last verified: August 20, 2026

- The current version is Design Draft 1 and contains placeholders for prices,
  product details, images, contact information, and legal text.
- The contact form intentionally prevents real submission. The delivery method
  will be decided after the hosting decision.
- Facebook and Instagram are prepared visually but remain unlinked while their
  targets in `src/data/site.ts` are set to `null`.
- The legal notice and privacy policy are drafts and are excluded from indexing
  with `noindex, nofollow`.
- There are no automated tests. The agreed acceptance process consists of a
  production build and manual checks on desktop and mobile devices.
- The old website analysis contains unverified historical information and must
  not be published directly.
- Design Draft 2 is only planned. The theme source, final repository name, and
  exact migration strategy are still undecided.
